Jwt.__Key_NOTE: Do not put the key here. Run: dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "..." (Development), or set the Jwt__Key environment variable (other environments).

DatabaseBackup.__NOTE: Path on the SQL Server host's OWN filesystem (BACKUP DATABASE runs server-side, not on this app's machine) — e.g. /var/opt/mssql/backup on Linux or C:\Backups\SynteraERP on Windows. Leave empty to disable the automatic monthly backup.
